post.title: Nearly 4 in 10 Run Out of Jobless Benefits Before a New Job
post.ig:
Nearly 4 in 10 people run out of unemployment benefits before they land a new job (NPR, Oct 11, 2026).
Layoffs are rare: weekly jobless claims are near a 57-year low (Reuters, Oct 8, 2026).
But the median stretch of unemployment was 11.5 weeks in September, and 1.9 million people (27.1% of the unemployed) have been jobless 27+ weeks (BLS).
Colorado pays up to six months of benefits; North Carolina pays 12 weeks. The average US weekly check is about $492 (Labor Department, 12 months to July 2026).
Sources: NPR, BLS, Reuters, US Department of Labor.
